title: Re-migrate biome.json to the installed Biome 2.5.14
description:
biome.json pins $schema 2.5.12 while the installed @biomejs/biome is 2.5.13, so every `npm run check` reports one info-level diagnostic ("Run the command biome migrate to migrate the configuration file"). Info does not fail the build, but AGENTS.md Formatting & Linting requires keeping biome.json migrated to the installed Biome precisely so info noise cannot accumulate.

Cause: the config was migrated under eshyra-ldtn (a5779df0) and a later routine dependency bump moved Biome to 2.5.13 without re-running the migration.

Fix: `npx biome migrate --write` from the worktree root, confirm `npm run check` reports zero info, and keep it in its own dependency-adjacent PR - not folded into feature work.

Observed on branch eshyra-5wbx (2026-09-22); present on main.
notes: PR #563 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/563). Target moved to 2.5.14 after PR #555 bumped the lockfile. verify:worktree clean. Close after merge.
